preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of stones N for each player is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The final string S has a length of 2 * N.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'a'..'z' for c in S)
postconditions.description: All characters in the final string S are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: S is lexicographically smallest possible under the optimal play of Alice and Bob
postconditions.description: The final string S is the lexicographically smallest possible string that can be formed by the optimal play of Alice and Bob.
